title: Chants, Rhymes and Action Songs
introduction: Practise chants, rhymes and action songs with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Rhymes repeat ending sounds and chants use rhythm. Actions help us enjoy and remember words.
rules: Say this original chant: Clap your hands, tap your feet. Say hello to friends you meet.
Clap a steady beat as you say the words.
Make up an action for each line.
